title: THE AJMER TENANCY AND LAND RECORDS ACT, 1950
long_title: An Act to provide for the regulation of tenancies and the preparation and maintenance of record-of-rights in land in the State of Ajmer.

sections.text: This Act may be called the Ajmer Tenancy and Land Records Act, 1950. It extends to the whole of the State of Ajmer and shall come into force on such date as the State Government may by notification appoint.
Repeals certain earlier enactments relating to tenancy and land records in Ajmer, subject to savings.
Provides for the continuance of rights, liabilities and proceedings under the repealed enactments.
Defines key terms including agricultural year, holding, improvement, land, landlord, niji jot, occupancy tenant, rent, tenant, and other expressions used in the Act.

sections.section_title: Power of landlord and tenant to act through agent
sections.text: A landlord or tenant may act through an authorised agent for the purposes of this Act.
Enumerates the primary rights of a tenant, including the right to exclusive possession, to the produce of the holding, and other incidental rights.
Prohibits certain acts by landlords or others that would interfere with the primary rights of tenants.

sections.section_title: Prohibition against deprivation of certain rights
sections.text: No tenant shall be deprived of certain specified rights except in accordance with the provisions of this Act.
Preserves certain rights of the landlord consistent with the rights conferred on tenants.

Defines niji jot (land under the personal cultivation of the landlord), provides for applications for demarcation, the order and procedure of demarcation, the status of tenants of niji jot, succession to niji jot, and the Collector’s powers to let such land to tenants.
Classifies tenants into occupancy tenants, exproprietary tenants, hereditary tenants and non-occupancy tenants.
Defines occupancy tenants and the conditions under which occupancy rights are held.
Deals with exproprietary tenants, acquisition of exproprietary rights, and relinquishment of such rights.
Defines hereditary tenants and specifies land in which hereditary rights shall not accrue.
Defines non-occupancy tenants and their rights and liabilities.

chapters.chapter_title: DEVOLUTION, TRANSFER, EXTINCTION, DIVISION, EXCHANGE AND ACQUISITION

sections.text: Provides whether the interest of a tenant is heritable and transferable, prohibits certain kinds of transfer or sub-lease, and regulates the right to sub-let.
Specifies when a tenancy is extinguished, the effect of extinction on life tenancies of females, the rights of sub-tenants, and the procedure for vacating the holding.

sections.section_title: Division, exchange and acquisition of holdings
sections.text: Provides for division of holdings, co-tenant’s right to claim division of produce, exchange of land for consolidation, acquisition of land by the landlord for certain purposes, decision of disputes arising out of acquisition, reinstatement of ejected tenants, and acquisition of proprietary right by the tenant.
Gives tenants the right to a written lease and provides the procedure to obtain it; requires registration of certain leases.
Empowers the court or revenue officer to declare the rights of parties in certain cases.
Regulates the right of different classes of tenants to make improvements on their holdings, the compensation payable therefor, and related matters.

Provides for the determination of rent payable by different classes of tenants, the grounds and procedure for enhancement or reduction of rent, commutation of rent in kind into cash, and other related matters.
Regulates the time and place of payment of rent, the issue of receipts, the recovery of arrears of rent as arrears of land revenue or by suit, and the protection of tenants against illegal exactions.
Specifies the grounds on which different classes of tenants may be ejected, the procedure for ejectment suits, the relief against ejectment, and the consequences of ejectment.

chapters.chapter_title: GRANT OF LAND AND ADMISSION TO TENANCY

sections.section_title: Grant of land and admission to tenancy
sections.text: Regulates the grant of land by landlords and the admission of persons as tenants, including the formalities and the effect of such admission.

chapters.chapter_title: RECORD OF RIGHTS AND LAND RECORDS

sections.section_title: Record of rights and land records
sections.text: Provides for the preparation, maintenance and revision of the record-of-rights, the land records, the duties of village officers, the correction of entries, and the evidentiary value of the records.

chapters.chapter_title: PROCEDURE AND JURISDICTION OF COURTS AND REVENUE OFFICERS

sections.text: Lays down the jurisdiction of civil courts and revenue officers in matters arising under the Act, the procedure to be followed, appeals, revisions and reviews.
Provides penalties for various offences under the Act, the power to make rules, the removal of difficulties, and other miscellaneous provisions.
